title: passk task
description: A task passk can bench: how to set the desktop up, what to ask the agent, and how to verify the outcome inside the VM.

id.description: Short slug; names the snapshot and the run folders.

template.description: Solari desktop template: default | office | code | a custom template id.

max_steps.description: Hard cap on agent actions per run. A run that hits it is graded on its checks, with the cap recorded as its stop reason.

prompt.description: Exactly what a user would type. Ambiguity is allowed; the probe will find it.

setup.description: Runs once before the snapshot, so forks pay none of it.

exec.description: Program to run (argv, not a shell; use sh -c for shell syntax).

open.description: GUI app to launch by name, e.g. mousepad, thunar, libreoffice.

upload.description: Local file, relative to the working directory.

to.description: Guest path. Files the agent must attach in Chrome belong under /home/desktop, not /root.

press.description: A key or +-joined chord: Return, ctrl+l, alt+F4.

type.description: Literal text to type into whatever has focus.

golden.description: Steps that produce the correct end state without an agent. `passk validate` proves the checks fail before them and pass after them.

checks.description: Evaluated inside the desktop after the agent stops. A run passes only if every check passes. Nothing the agent says counts.

invariant.description: A guard that must hold before and after the agent acts, not a goal.

name.description: Human label shown in reports instead of the raw path or command. Does not affect grading or the task hash.
